why.title: Why SPAN
why.subtitle1: Complex projects rarely fail from lack of expertise and innovation
why.text1_part2: We have good technology, but no clear roadmap.
why.text1_part5: The founder is handling everything alone.
why.text1_part6: We're preparing a fundraising round and need a credible plan.
why.text1_part7: We're missing an experienced CTO, but can't afford to hire one full-time.
why.text1_part8: We need better project coordination, but hiring a full-time PM isn't realistic yet.
why.text1_part10: These symptoms usually point to the same root cause: friction at the interfaces between disciplines. They fail at the interfaces between disciplines. This is especially true in high-stakes, regulated environments like MedTech, where ideas and technologies are strong, but challenges and bottlenecks often arise in:
why.text1_part12: Cross-functional coordination causing delays and potential project risks,
why.text1_part14: Limited resources for advanced systems engineering practices slowing development,
why.text2_part2: helps your teams connect those interfaces: so decisions move faster, risks stay visible, and nothing falls through the cracks between strategy, engineering, clinical, quality and regulatory.
why.card1_text: Connecting people, skills, data and disciplines around a shared understanding of the product to create lasting synergies.
why.card2_text: Structuring decisions and reducing risk through a genuine systems-level view of the project.
why.card3_text: Maximize the operational, economic and, where relevant, clinical value of your innovation.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Who's behind span?
about.text_part1: After 20+ years across medical devices development, I observe that projects stalled were rarely missing expertise, they were missing connections.
about.text_part2c: to make those connections explicit: bringing the right people and the right structure together at the right moment in a project's development, so teams can move faster and with more confidence.
about.text_part3: Today, I am eager to bring this same systems approach beyond healthcare, to environmental, sustainability-driven, and industrial technologies, with the same rigor and commitment to meaningful outcomes.
about.text_part4: The vision is simple: every complex project should benefit from a genuine systems view, from need to outcome.
about.sign_part1c: Fractional R&D Leader | Systems Thinking Partner | Innovation across MedTech & Complex Systems
about.sign_part1d: RS6099 Certified | PMP® Certification – Training completed, exam pending
about.val_part1b: Integrity, Transparence, Rigor, Scientific curiosity, Positivity.

whom.title: For whom?
whom.text_part1: Consultancy tailored for Tech start-ups, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) and stakeholders looking to drive innovation and sustainable team and product growth.
whom.text_part3b: Complex, regulated industries more broadly (environmental & sustainability-driven technologies, industrial systems) wherever the same systemic challenges apply.
whom.text_part4b: Medical ultrasound, Complex and critical embedded systems, IoT, AI technologies, Biomonitoring, Biomechanics — with transferable expertise in systems engineering & integration, cross-functional governance, applicable wherever systems are complex and stakes are high.
whom.text_part5b: Based in Toulouse, France — available on-site across France and Europe, or remotely.
